title: Money
description: Class 2 IMO — Indian money: coins and notes, making amounts, adding and subtracting rupees, and giving change in everyday shopping problems.

topics.title: Coins and Notes
topics.concept: Indian money is counted in rupees (₹). We have coins of ₹1, ₹2, ₹5 and ₹10, and notes of ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100 and more. The same amount can be made in different ways — ₹10 can be one ₹10 coin, or two ₹5 coins, or five ₹2 coins.
recap: The same amount can be made many ways.

topics.title: Adding and Subtracting Money
topics.concept: We add and subtract money just like ordinary numbers, keeping the ₹ sign. To find the total cost, add the prices. To find the change, subtract the cost from the money given.

examples.problem: A pen costs ₹12 and a pencil ₹8. Total cost?
You pay ₹50 for a ₹35 book. Change?

recap: Add prices to get the total cost.

quiz.q: A toy costs ₹25 and a ball ₹15. Total cost?
You pay ₹100 for goods worth ₹70. How much change?

topics.title: Shopping Problems
topics.concept: In shops we often buy more than one thing. Add up all the costs to find the total, then work out the change. Sometimes we check whether the money we have is enough.

examples.problem: You have ₹40. A book costs ₹55. Enough?
examples.solution: No — ₹55 is more than ₹40; you need ₹15 more.

recap: Add all item prices for the total.
Compare money with cost to see if it is enough.

quiz.q: Ravi has ₹30. A cricket ball costs ₹45. How much more does he need?

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three equal ₹20):  two ₹10 notes, four ₹5 coins, ten ₹2 coins, five ₹5 coins?
questions.explanation: Five ₹5 coins = ₹25; the other three equal ₹20.

questions.q: ₹5 coin is to ₹10 as ₹10 note is to ___ (double it)?
Which is more money — three ₹10 coins or one ₹20 note?
A pencil box costs ₹45 and a water bottle ₹55. Total cost?
You buy items for ₹62 and pay with a ₹100 note. Change?
An ice cream costs ₹15. How much for 2 ice creams?
Meena has one ₹50 note, one ₹20 note and one ₹10 coin. How much money in all?
Pens cost ₹8 each. With ₹50, how many pens can you buy at most?
questions.explanation: 6 pens cost 6 × 8 = ₹48 (₹2 left); 7 would cost ₹56 — too much.
